config.study: Trailing beta hedge versus inherited unused-budget hedge
config.scope: All20seeds including the recently confirmed cohort now form development for this new risk arm. No seed omitted. No new fitting.
config.controls: original20 reproduces every existing account; cash15 reduces stock volatility target to15% with the old unused-budget QQQ hedge. Both beta rules retain20%stockvol target and reduce long budget to<=1/(1+positive beta).
config.beta: Current chosen stock-basket beta againstQQQ from preceding60or120close returns only. Use complete basket-return days, require half-window or20days, else beta1. Clip beta[0,3]. Long=min(20%/basketvol20,1/(1+beta)); short=min75%,beta*long,20%/QQQvol20. No leverage or short-proceeds reinvestment. Actual beta can drift and caps can prevent neutrality.
config.aggregation: Neural baseline pools seed rankings then selects5issuers. Prior candidate is the frozen26week prior/neural blend with5issuer portfolios averaged across consecutive5seedcohorts. Portfolio execution,fees,borrow,ADV,cash,fills unchanged.
config.goal: Base-costSR>1.5 in every one of seven groups, four-disjoint-cohort spread<=0.35, and worst stressed-costSR>=1.0. Only nonbaseline risk policies qualify. Report all168cases and every original20parity check.
config.selection: Among qualifying policies maximize minimum all7SR, break ties by meanSR thenmodel/policy lexical order. Freeze chosen rule before any additional seeds are fitted.
config.next_seed_reserve: If target passes, next5unused October20list new_seeds[15:20], no filtering; fixed candidate and reference on these seeds plus expanded25. This remains initialization confirmation, not unseen market data.
